annotations.description: admissionController.annotations -- Annotations to add to the admission controller deployment

repository.description: admissionController.certGen.image.repository -- An image that contains certgen for creating certificates. Only used if admissionController.generateCertificate is true

tag.description: admissionController.certGen.image.tag -- An image tag for the admissionController.certGen.image.repository image. Only used if admissionController.generateCertificate is true

enabled.description: admissionController.enabled -- If true, will install the admission-controller component of vpa

extraArgs.description: admissionController.extraArgs -- A key-value map of flags to pass to the admissionController

generateCertificate.description: admissionController.generateCertificate -- If true and admissionController is enabled, a pre-install hook will run to create the certificate for the webhook

httpPort.description: admissionController.httpPort -- Port of the admission controller for the mutating webhooks

pullPolicy.description: admissionController.image.pullPolicy -- The pull policy for the admission controller image. Recommend not changing this

repository.description: admissionController.image.repository -- The location of the vpa admission controller image

tag.description: admissionController.image.tag -- Overrides the image tag whose default is the chart appVersion

livenessProbe.description: admissionController.livenessProbe -- The liveness probe definition inside the admission controller pod

metricsPort.description: admissionController.metricsPort -- Port of the admission controller where metrics can be received from

annotations.description: admissionController.mutatingWebhookConfiguration.annotations -- Additional annotations for the MutatingWebhookConfiguration. Can be used for integration with cert-manager

failurePolicy.description: admissionController.mutatingWebhookConfiguration.failurePolicy -- The failurePolicy for the mutating webhook. Allowed values are: Ignore, Fail

namespaceSelector.description: admissionController.mutatingWebhookConfiguration.namespaceSelector -- The namespaceSelector controls, which namespaces are affected by the webhook

objectSelector.description: admissionController.mutatingWebhookConfiguration.objectSelector -- The objectSelector can filter object on e.g. labels

timeoutSeconds.description: admissionController.mutatingWebhookConfiguration.timeout -- Sets the amount of time the API server will wait on a response from the webhook service.

nodeSelector.description:
- key: ca.crt
path: caCert.pem
- key: tls.crt
path: serverCert.pem
- key: tls.key
path: serverKey.pem

podAnnotations.description: admissionController.podAnnotations -- Annotations to add to the admission controller pod

podDisruptionBudget.description: admissionController.podDisruptionBudget -- This is the setting for the pod disruption budget

podLabels.description: admissionController.podLabels -- Labels to add to the admission controller pod

podSecurityContext.description: admissionController.podSecurityContext -- The security context for the admission controller pod

readinessProbe.description: admissionController.readinessProbe -- The readiness probe definition inside the admission controller pod

registerWebhook.description: admissionController.registerWebhook -- If true, will allow the vpa admission controller to register itself as a mutating webhook

resources.description: admissionController.resources -- The resources block for the admission controller pod

revisionHistoryLimit.description: admissionController.revisionHistoryLimit -- The number of old replicasets to retain, default is 10, 0 will garbage-collect old replicasets

secretName.description: admissionController.secretName -- Name for the TLS secret created for the webhook. Default {{ .Release.Name }}-tls-secret

securityContext.description: admissionController.securityContext -- The security context for the containers inside the admission controller pod

tlsSecretKeys.description: admissionController.tlsSecretKeys -- The keys in the vpa-tls-certs secret to map in to the admission controller

useHostNetwork.description: admissionController.useHostNetwork -- Whether to use host network, this is required on EKS with custom CNI

imagePullSecrets.description: imagePullSecrets -- A list of image pull secrets to be used for all pods
